query: WITH expired AS ( SELECT request.id, request.started_at FROM requests_default request WHERE request.started_at < $1 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM attempts attempt WHERE attempt.request_id = request.id AND attempt.request_started_at = request.started_at ) LIMIT $2 FOR UPDATE OF request SKIP LOCKED ) DELETE FROM requests_default request USING expired WHERE request.id = expired.id AND request.started_at = expired.started_at
